<div class="card-body">
'''Clak'dor VII''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊クラクドアVII</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを占領しているなら、ビスのキャラクターは全員、戦闘力＋2となる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、ビスのキャラクターは全員、運命数－1となり、ギックはデジャリックのゲームにおいて戦闘力＋2となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Clakdor-VII-PSA-161939275.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Clak'dor VII.

'''Light Side:'''
If you occupy here, all Bith characters are power +2.

'''Dark Side:'''
If you control here, all Bith characters are destiny -1, and Ghhhk is power +2 in the Dejarik game.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Light is power +2; English is destiny +2. Dark names ギック.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Clak'dor VII]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
